steps.name: environment - verify node/npm and persist npm global bin path (non-destructive)
steps.description: Validate Node (v18+) and npm presence and versions. Export NODE_ENV=development only for the current run to ensure devDependencies install. Persist npm global bin path into /etc/profile.d/playwright_env.sh in a safe way without persisting NODE_ENV. Do not persist PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_BROWSER_DOWNLOAD. If npm is missing or Node version is too old, fail with clear messages.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/playwright-automation-suite-293573-293582/playwright_automation_runner"
mkdir -p "$WORKSPACE"
# check node
if ! command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "Error: node not found on PATH" >&2; exit 2; fi
node_version=$(node -v | sed 's/^v//')
node_major=$(printf "%s" "$node_version" | cut -d. -f1)
if [ "${node_major:-0}" -lt 18 ]; then echo "Error: Node v18+ required; detected v${node_version}" >&2; exit 3; fi
# check npm
if ! command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "Error: npm not found on PATH" >&2; exit 4; fi
npm_version=$(npm -v)
# determine npm global bin with fallback
NPM_GLOBAL_BIN=$(npm bin -g 2>/dev/null || echo "/usr/local/bin")
# Persist npm global bin safely without forcing NODE_ENV system-wide
sudo tee /etc/profile.d/playwright_env.sh >/dev/null <<'EOF'
# Added by playwright setup - ensure npm global bin on PATH for future sessions
export PATH="${NPM_GLOBAL_BIN}:$PATH"
EOF
sudo chmod 644 /etc/profile.d/playwright_env.sh
# Ensure current run exports NODE_ENV=development for installs; do NOT persist system-wide by default
export NODE_ENV=development
# Ensure PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_BROWSER_DOWNLOAD default for this run only
export PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_BROWSER_DOWNLOAD="${PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_BROWSER_DOWNLOAD:-false}"
# concise diagnostic
echo "node=${node_version} npm=${npm_version} npm_global_bin=${NPM_GLOBAL_BIN}"
exit 0

steps.name: dependencies - install npm deps and Playwright browsers (idempotent, with remediation hints)
steps.description: Install devDependencies reproducibly (npm ci when lockfile present) with NODE_ENV=development forced for the install run. Prefer local CLI at ./node_modules/.bin/playwright. When PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_BROWSER_DOWNLOAD is not true, run playwright install --with-deps (idempotent). On failure, emit actionable remediation hints listing common apt packages required for --with-deps. Do not run apt-get automatically. Verify playwright CLI presence after install.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/playwright-automation-suite-293573-293582/playwright_automation_runner"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
# Force dev install environment for this run
export NODE_ENV=development
# install reproducibly
if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then
  npm ci --no-audit --no-fund || { echo "Error: 'npm ci' failed; inspect npm output above" >&2; exit 5; }
else
  npm i --no-audit --no-fund || { echo "Error: 'npm install' failed; inspect npm output above" >&2; exit 6; }
fi
PLAYWRIGHT_BIN="./node_modules/.bin/playwright"
SKIP_DOWNLOAD="${PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_BROWSER_DOWNLOAD:-false}"
# If not skipping downloads, attempt install (idempotent). Prefer local CLI; fail with guidance if missing.
if [ "$SKIP_DOWNLOAD" != "true" ]; then
  if [ -x "$PLAYWRIGHT_BIN" ]; then
    # run install unconditionally (idempotent). Capture stderr to provide remediation hints on failure
    if ! "$PLAYWRIGHT_BIN" install --with-deps 2> >(tee /tmp/playwright_install_err.log >&2); then
      echo "Error: playwright install --with-deps failed; common apt packages needed: ca-certificates, fonts-liberation, libnss3, libatk1.0-0, libx11-6, libxkbcommon0, libgtk-3-0, libxss1" >&2
      echo "Inspect /tmp/playwright_install_err.log for details" >&2
      exit 7
    fi
  else
    if command -v npx >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      if ! npx playwright install --with-deps 2> >(tee /tmp/playwright_install_err.log >&2); then
        echo "Error: npx playwright install --with-deps failed; see /tmp/playwright_install_err.log. Common packages: ca-certificates fonts-liberation libnss3 libatk1.0-0 libx11-6 libxkbcommon0 libgtk-3-0 libxss1" >&2
        exit 8
      fi
    else
      echo "Error: playwright binary not found and npx unavailable; add '@playwright/test' or 'playwright' to devDependencies and reinstall" >&2
      exit 9
    fi
  fi
fi
# verify CLI availability
if [ -x "$PLAYWRIGHT_BIN" ]; then
  "$PLAYWRIGHT_BIN" --version || { echo "Error: playwright CLI exists but failed --version check" >&2; exit 10; }
else
  if command -v npx >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    npx playwright --version >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "Error: playwright CLI not available after install" >&2; exit 11; }
  else
    echo "Warning: playwright CLI not found after install" >&2
  fi
fi
exit 0

steps.name: validation - build, start local server if present, run tests and cleanup
steps.description: If package.json contains a build script, run it. If index.html exists, start a local python static server and run Playwright tests against the local URL (LOCAL_TEST_URL env). Capture test exit code reliably, ensure server cleanup via trap, and print concise evidence (node/npm/playwright versions and workspace listing). Fail with actionable messages on errors.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/playwright-automation-suite-293573-293582/playwright_automation_runner"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
# evidence
echo "node: $(node -v) npm: $(npm -v)"
PLAYWRIGHT_BIN="./node_modules/.bin/playwright"
if [ -x "$PLAYWRIGHT_BIN" ]; then
  "$PLAYWRIGHT_BIN" --version || true
fi
# run build if package.json has a build script
if [ -f package.json ] && grep -q '"build"' package.json; then
  npm run build || { echo "Build failed" >&2; exit 13; }
fi
SERVER_PID=0
PORT=3000
trap 'if [ "$SERVER_PID" -ne 0 ] && kill -0 "$SERVER_PID" >/dev/null 2>&1; then kill "$SERVER_PID" || true; fi' EXIT
LOCAL_URL="http://127.0.0.1:$PORT"
if [ -f index.html ]; then
  python3 -m http.server "$PORT" >/dev/null 2>&1 &
  SERVER_PID=$!
  attempts=0; max=10
  until curl -s --max-time 2 "$LOCAL_URL" >/dev/null 2>&1; do
    attempts=$((attempts+1))
    if [ $attempts -ge $max ]; then
      echo "Error: static server did not become healthy after $max attempts" >&2
      exit 14
    fi
    sleep 1
  done
  export LOCAL_TEST_URL="$LOCAL_URL"
fi
export DISPLAY="${DISPLAY:-:99}"
# run tests and capture exit code reliably
TEST_EXIT=0
if [ -x "$PLAYWRIGHT_BIN" ]; then
  "$PLAYWRIGHT_BIN" test --reporter=list --workers=1 || TEST_EXIT=$?
else
  if command -v npx >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    npx playwright test --reporter=list --workers=1 || TEST_EXIT=$?
  else
    echo "Error: playwright CLI not available for validation" >&2; TEST_EXIT=15
  fi
fi
# server will be cleaned by trap on EXIT
if [ "$TEST_EXIT" -ne 0 ]; then
  echo "Validation tests failed with exit ${TEST_EXIT}" >&2
  exit ${TEST_EXIT}
fi
# Evidence listing
ls -la "$WORKSPACE" | sed -n '1,40p'
exit 0

  done
  export LOCAL_TEST_URL="$LOCAL_URL"
  echo "Static server started at $LOCAL_TEST_URL (pid $SERVER_PID)"
fi
export DISPLAY="${DISPLAY:-:99}"
# run Playwright tests and capture exit code reliably
TEST_EXIT=0
if [ -x "$PLAYWRIGHT_BIN" ]; then
  "$PLAYWRIGHT_BIN" test --reporter=list --workers=1 || TEST_EXIT=$?
else
  if command -v npx >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    npx --yes playwright test --reporter=list --workers=1 || TEST_EXIT=$?
  else
    echo "Error: playwright CLI not available (no local ./node_modules/.bin/playwright and no npx). Install devDependency 'playwright' or use 'npx playwright'." >&2
    TEST_EXIT=15
  fi
fi
# If tests failed, print concise evidence then exit with same code
if [ "$TEST_EXIT" -ne 0 ]; then
  echo "Validation tests failed with exit ${TEST_EXIT}" >&2
  echo "-- Evidence --"
  echo "node: $(node -v) npm: $(npm -v)"
  if [ -x "$PLAYWRIGHT_BIN" ]; then
    "$PLAYWRIGHT_BIN" --version || true
  fi
  ls -la "$WORKSPACE" | sed -n '1,40p'
  exit "$TEST_EXIT"
fi
# success: print evidence and exit 0
echo "-- Evidence --"
echo "node: $(node -v) npm: $(npm -v)"
if [ -x "$PLAYWRIGHT_BIN" ]; then
  "$PLAYWRIGHT_BIN" --version || true
fi
ls -la "$WORKSPACE" | sed -n '1,40p'
exit 0
